query: SELECT p.id,p.sku,p.price,p.stock,p.name FROM product p JOIN category c ON c.id=p.category_id WHERE p.status='ON_SALE' AND c.parent_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC,p.id ASC;

SELECT p.id,p.sku,p.price,p.stock,p.name FROM product p JOIN category c ON c.id=p.category_id WHERE p.status='ON_SALE' AND c.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND p.name LIKE (CONVERT(0x25e6af95e4b89a25 USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_ci) ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC,p.id ASC;

SELECT p.id,p.sku,p.price,p.stock,p.name FROM product p JOIN category c ON c.id=p.category_id WHERE p.status='ON_SALE' AND c.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND c.parent_id=1 ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC,p.id ASC;
